pages.text:
## HISTORY AND PHYSICAL
Date: 10/12/2026
## CC
Wheezing and shortness of breath x 2 days
## HPI
34 y/o F with moderate persistent asthma, unhoused x 1 yr (sleeps in her car until it was towed 3 weeks ago, now outdoors), presents with wheezing and dyspnea after wildfire smoke exposure and running out of her controller inhaler. In ED SpO2 90% RA, given continuous albuterol nebs, IV methylprednisolone, magnesium. Placed on 2L NC.
No prior intubations. No ICU admissions.
## PMH
- Asthma since childhood
- Seasonal allergic rhinitis
## Meds PTA
Albuterol inhaler PRN (ran out); fluticasone-salmeterol (ran out 1 month ago)
## Allergies
Penicillin (rash)
## Social
Never smoker. Rare EtOH. Denies drug use.
## Exam
T 98.6F HR 112 BP 132/84 RR 26 SpO2 93% 2L NC. Diffuse expiratory wheezes. Speaking in short sentences. AOx4.
## Assessment/Plan
1. Acute asthma exacerbation - albuterol/ipratropium nebs q4h, methylprednisolone 40 mg IV q12h then prednisone taper, O2 to SpO2 >= 92%
2. Dispo - SW consult (unhoused)
Signed: Miguel Castellano, MD 10/12/2026 05:20
